title: Brookes Engage
description: A 15-month academic-year widening-participation programme (not a summer camp) for students starting the first year of a two-year Level 3 qualification (A Levels, BTEC or equivalent). Combines masterclass days during the academic year, a short summer school component, and Year 13 ongoing support through to a March 2028 graduation.
residency_restrictions: Must attend a non-selective state school or college in England (independent/private-school and non-England students are not eligible); must additionally meet at least one widening-participation criterion (free school meals, care experience, young carer, ethnic minority background, refugee/asylum seeker status, or residence in a high-deprivation area by postcode).
application_requirements: attend a non-selective state school/college in England
meet at least one listed widening-participation criterion
selectivity_evidence: Eligibility-gated (school type + socioeconomic/demographic criteria) rather than competitively selective on academic merit; not claiming a selectivity_tier above open_enrollment.
verification_status: Verified - official Oxford Brookes page fetched directly, 2026-08-22, confirms dates, funding, and eligibility criteria in the university's own words.
notes: NOT Turkey/Europe-international-weighted despite the assignment's stated weighting: this program is explicitly restricted to state-school students resident in England, which excludes international and private-school students entirely. Recorded anyway because it is a genuine, well-verified academic_program-category fill (a category with only 3 prior rows) and because the England-residency gate is itself a useful, structural finding of the same shape as THIMUN's school-gating (flagged to the coordinator separately) -- an eligibility constraint no existing schema field captures cleanly (not just a country restriction, but a school-type + means-tested-criteria gate). No numeric application deadline found on the official page. cycle_status left as 'unverified' rather than 'open' since the page did not state whether the 2026 cohort intake is still accepting applications as of this research date. SOURCE-AUTHORITY: domain brookes.ac.uk contains '.ac.' and passes looksOfficial() -- a genuine positive counter-example to this batch's pattern of otherwise-legitimate organisers failing the gate. Cost detail: all travel and meals for in-person activities provided at no cost; explicitly stated as fully funded.
